analyst.summary: Ajanta Pharma delivered another strong FY26 (revenue +17% to Rs.5,453 cr, PAT +15% to Rs.1,056 cr) led by a maturing US Generics ramp (+49% to Rs.1,557 cr) and market-beating India branded-generics volumes, on a debt-free balance sheet with best-in-class return ratios (ROE 27%, ROCE 34.5%). A Q4 forex swing masked stronger underlying operating growth, and an April-2026 USFDA inspection at the Paithan plant closed at the mildest (VAI) classification with no warning letter. Set against this, the stock's ~39x P/E already prices in more growth than management's own 16-18% FY27 guidance implies, and elevated promoter share-pledging tied to unrelated group businesses is a governance item to watch. Rated Hold pending the firm's quant score.
